mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed arc represents the hidden portion of the rim of the cylinder’s right end. Right image: The dashed trace is the graph of g with a marked point at (2, −4).
Rationales: The feature shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the left image and plots the values of a function in the right image. The dashed arc on the back half of the right cylinder end. The dashed magenta downward-opening parabola labeled g.
